claim.quote: A relatively low value close to 0.5 m was found for the attenuation length of the liquid argon bulk to its own scintillation light.

key_value.note: Attenuation length of the LAr bulk for its own scintillation light; 'close to' in the abstract.

name: Measurement of the attenuation length of argon scintillation light in the ArDM LAr TPC

summary.plain: ArDM measured how far argon scintillation light travels in its liquid argon and found it surprisingly short, which the authors attribute to impurities.
summary.technical: Attenuation length of the argon scintillation light in the tonne-scale target from 39Ar and 83mKr light-yield spectra compared with a ray-tracing model (single-phase run); the low value is interpreted as optically active impurities not removed by the purification systems.

title: Measurement of the attenuation length of argon scintillation light in the ArDM LAr TPC
why_it_matters: It shows that impurity control matters for large liquid argon detectors; the abstract interprets the low value as optically active impurities.
